value.rationale: A complete all-target inverse-image stratification for a high-dimensional canonical coupled map, and exact \(1,2^N,3^N\) regimes on the natural observation cube, identify when backward reconstruction is unique and when global folding becomes visible. This supplies structural data potentially useful in inverse dynamics and basin analysis; no unsupported future theorem is claimed.
